title: The Bouncer — EN/ES/FR (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational 102bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal English Spanish French language learning trilingual
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
The bouncer doesn't knock on the door
The bouncer comes through the window at head height
And waits to see what you do about that

[Verse 2 — Español]
Un buen bouncer no se trata de agresión [A good bouncer is not about aggression]
Es una pregunta [It's a question]
¿Sigues aquí? [Are you still here?]
¿Sigues pensando? [Are you still thinking?]
¿O ya estás en otro lugar? [Or are you already somewhere else?]

[Chorus — English]
The bouncer says — good morning
The bouncer says — how do you do
The bouncer says — I know where you're standing
Do you know what I'm about to do

[Bridge — Français]
Le bouncer dit — bonjour [The bouncer says — good morning]
Le bouncer dit — comment allez-vous [The bouncer says — how do you do]
Le bouncer dit — je sais où vous vous tenez [The bouncer says — I know where you're standing]
Savez-vous ce que je vais faire? [Do you know what I'm about to do?]

[Verse 3 — English]
Chas would watch the short ball with a quiet eye
Said — son, the bouncer's never about fury
It's about information

[Outro — EN/ES/FR]
That's the bouncer
Eso es el bouncer [That's the bouncer]
C'est le bouncer [That's the bouncer]
That's my boy
